contract.requirement: Every released evaluation must tell a Consumer Engineer what ran, what it found, where it found it, how to remediate it, why the gate concluded, and where durable evidence lives.

.github/workflows/ai-code-review.yml.consumer_surface: Pull-request comment, job summary, structured outputs, and durable evaluation-result-ai-code-review artifact

.github/workflows/ecosystem-baseline.yml.consumer_surface: Profile Conclusion job summary and ecosystem-baseline-evidence bundle
.github/workflows/ecosystem-baseline.yml.remediation_surface: Per-evaluation gate reason, scope, and evidence mapping

.github/workflows/evaluation-pipeline.ym.consumer_surface: Profile Conclusion job summary and evidence-bundle artifact
.github/workflows/evaluation-pipeline.ym.remediation_surface: Per-evaluation gate reason, scope, and evidence mapping

.github/workflows/sec-actions.yml.consumer_surface: GitHub job summary, source annotations, normalized result, and Zizmor SARIF artifact
.github/workflows/sec-actions.yml.remediation_surface: Zizmor rule guidance plus workflow-hardening instructions

.github/workflows/sec-codeql.yml.consumer_surface: GitHub Code Scanning alerts with source locations and query help
.github/workflows/sec-codeql.yml.remediation_surface: CodeQL query help and alert remediation guidance

.github/workflows/sec-dependencies.yml.consumer_surface: GitHub job summary, source annotations, normalized result, and Trivy SARIF artifact

.github/workflows/sec-dependency-review..consumer_surface: Dependency Review pull-request summary and annotations
.github/workflows/sec-dependency-review..remediation_surface: Dependency Review advisory and license guidance

.github/workflows/sec-iac.yml.consumer_surface: GitHub job summary, source annotations, normalized result, and Trivy SARIF artifact

.github/workflows/sec-licenses.yml.consumer_surface: GitHub job summary, source annotations, normalized result, and Trivy SARIF artifact
.github/workflows/sec-licenses.yml.remediation_surface: License replacement, approval, and exception guidance

.github/workflows/sec-sbom.yml.consumer_surface: Downloadable CycloneDX software bill of materials
.github/workflows/sec-sbom.yml.remediation_surface: Inventory evidence for dependency triage and upgrade planning

.github/workflows/sec-scorecard.yml.consumer_surface: GitHub Code Scanning alerts and Scorecard SARIF artifact

.github/workflows/sec-secrets.yml.consumer_surface: GitHub job summary, redacted source annotations, normalized result, and Gitleaks SARIF artifact
.github/workflows/sec-secrets.yml.remediation_surface: Credential rotation, history removal, access review, and false-positive guidance

.github/workflows/sec-semgrep.yml.consumer_surface: GitHub job summary, source annotations, normalized result, and Semgrep SARIF artifact
.github/workflows/sec-semgrep.yml.remediation_surface: Rule guidance, safe replacement, regression-test, and suppression guidance

.github/workflows/sec-slither.yml.consumer_surface: GitHub Code Scanning alerts and Slither SARIF artifact
.github/workflows/sec-slither.yml.remediation_surface: Slither detector documentation and source locations

.github/workflows/security-pipeline.yml.consumer_surface: Individual evaluation summaries, annotations, provider alerts, and artifacts
.github/workflows/security-pipeline.yml.remediation_surface: Each composed evaluation owns its finding-specific remediation surface

actions/aggregate-results/action.yml.consumer_surface: Evidence Bundle and readable Profile Conclusion summary
actions/aggregate-results/action.yml.remediation_surface: Per-evaluation gate reason and evidence mapping

actions/ai-code-review/action.yml.consumer_surface: Pull-request comment, job summary, findings JSON, and Evaluation Result

actions/evaluation-adapter/action.yml.consumer_surface: Normalized result, job summary, annotations, and durable artifact identity
actions/evaluation-adapter/action.yml.remediation_surface: Rule help plus evaluation-specific remediation guidance

actions/gitleaks-scan/action.yml.consumer_surface: Redacted SARIF path and explicit scan scope

actions/scanner-outcome/action.yml.remediation_surface: Compatibility path; new evaluations must use the Evaluation Adapter

actions/semgrep-scan/action.yml.consumer_surface: SARIF path and scanner operational outcome

actions/zizmor-scan/action.yml.consumer_surface: SARIF path and scanner operational outcome
